elevate.move: Make the photos the paper the receipt is printed on: a tall hero strip with the receipt's torn-edge clip-path and one warm-paper grade, and checklist room tabs that each clip-wipe in a process photo alongside their line items, so the images become part of the signature.

Give the scroll one physical spine: a single receipt strip down the left third from hero to footer, where each section prints its line item (rooms, frequency, add-ons, total) while the right two-thirds carry the content, with one deliberate overlap where the torn edge crosses into the dark proof band.
